candidateOccurrences.sourceText: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The LORD said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。
